curriculum.name: Kenya Competency-Based Curriculum (CBC)
curriculum.tagline: Practical, value-driven, KICD-aligned learning for Kenyan families
curriculum.description: Comprehensive national curriculum approved by Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development (KICD) emphasizing core competencies, values, and community service learning.

term_package.title: Grade 4 CBC - Term 1 Master Homeschool-in-a-Box
term_package.subtitle: KICD Syllabi Aligned: Mathematics, Science & Tech, English, Kiswahili, Agriculture & Nutrition
features: 60 Daily Zero-Prep Lesson Guides with Parent Scripting
KNEC CBA Level 1-4 Performance Assessment Rubrics
Turnkey Kitchen Science & Balcony Agriculture Labs
Official MoE Term 1 Statutory Progress Report Card Generator

learning_outcomes: Demonstrate core conceptual understanding of Numbers up to 10,000 & Living Things.
Apply knowledge to hands-on problem solving using everyday Kenyan household materials.
Record observations in learner journal conforming to KNEC CBA Level 1-4 expectations.

lessons.subject: Mathematics & Numeracy
lessons.topic: Week 1 Numeracy: Numbers up to 10,000
lessons.parent_script: Ask: 'Jambo! Look around our living room. Can you find 3 objects that demonstrate today\'s math concept of Numbers up to 10,000?'
lessons.learning_objective: Learner correctly applies calculation techniques for Numbers up to 10,000 with 90%+ accuracy.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Warm up with 5 rapid mental math prompts.
2. Work through the 3 guided examples on page 3 of the printable pack.
3. Solve the 4 independent practical challenges.

lessons.subject: Science & Technology
lessons.topic: Week 1 Science: Place Value & Plant Forms
lessons.parent_script: Say: 'Scientists don\'t just read books; they investigate. Today we will explore Place Value & Plant Forms using items from our kitchen!'
lessons.learning_objective: Learner identifies key scientific principles of Place Value & Plant Forms and explains real-world implications.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Formulate a hypothesis before starting.
2. Follow safety guidelines and set up the apparatus.
3. Log before and after changes in table format.
lessons.worksheet_name: Worksheet #1.2 - Place Value & Plant Forms Lab Observation

lessons.subject: English Literacy & Syntax
lessons.topic: Week 1 English: Reading Comprehension & Sentence Mechanics
lessons.parent_script: Say: 'Let\'s read today\'s passage together. Pay attention to expression, full stops, and dialogue quotation marks.'
lessons.learning_objective: Learner reads at 110+ words per minute with proper punctuation inflection and answers 5 inferential comprehension questions.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Read passage aloud.
2. Circle 3 new vocabulary terms and look up definitions.
3. Write a 4-sentence summary in your own words.

lessons.subject: Kiswahili Lugha na Insha
lessons.topic: Wiki 1 Kiswahili: Sarufi, Ngeli na Utunzi
lessons.parent_script: Sema: 'Leo tutaangazia matumizi sahihi ya maneno na upatanisho wa kisarufi katika ngeli yetu ya wiki hii.'
lessons.learning_objective: Mwanafunzi atunge sentensi tano (5) sahihi zenye upatanisho wa kisarufi na maana kamili.
lessons.step_by_step_activity:
1. Soma mifano kwenye karatasi ya kazi.
2. Tambua viambishi awali na viambishi tamati.
3. Andika kifungu kifupi cha maneno 50.
lessons.worksheet_name: Kazi #1.4 - Mazoezi ya Lugha na Sarufi
